name: Fruit Dip
description: A simple and flavorful cream cheese dip infused with orange juice and marshmallow creme, ideal for fresh fruit.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients in a dish and beat until smooth and well blended.
Serve immediately with fresh cut-up fruit.

keywords: fruit dip, orange cream cheese, marshmallow dip

_similar.name: Fluffy Fruit Dip
_similar.description: A light and airy fruit dip made with softened cream cheese, marshmallow creme, and vanilla extract.

recipeInstructions.text: In a bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, marshmallow creme, and vanilla extract.
Mix until smooth and well blended.
Serve immediately with your choice of fresh fruit.

_similar.keywords: fluffy fruit dip, marshmallow dip, sweet appetizer

_similar.name: Yogurt Dip
_similar.description: A refreshing yogurt-based dip flavored with mayonnaise, herbs, and seasonings, perfect for vegetables.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup sour cream or plain yogurt

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.
Let sit in the fridge for 1 hour to allow flavors to meld.
Serve with vegetables.

_similar.keywords: yogurt dip, healthy dip, vegetable dip

_similar.name: Pina Colada Dip
_similar.description: A creamy and tropical dip made with pineapple, coconut pudding, and sour cream, perfect for serving with fresh fruit.
recipeIngredient: 3½ oz package instant coconut pudding and pie filling (or 1 vanilla pudding and ¼ cup shredded coconut with coconut extract)

recipeInstructions.text: Blend all ingredients together in a food processor or blender until smooth.
Refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to meld.
Serve chilled with a variety of fresh fruits.

_similar.keywords: pina colada dip, fruit dip, coconut pudding, party appetizer

_similar.name: Salmon Dip
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful red salmon spread perfect for crackers or sandwiches.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp garlic powder or 1 fresh garlic clove, minced

recipeInstructions.text: Drain the salmon and remove any bones.
Use a fork to flake the salmon before adding other ingredients.
Combine the softened cream cheese with the salmon and all remaining ingredients.
Mix well and serve with crackers or as a spread.

_similar.keywords: salmon dip, salmon spread, red salmon

_similar.name: Nacho Dip
_similar.description: A creamy and flavorful dip made with cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning, topped with salsa, cheese, and chopped vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning mix until smooth.
Spread the mixture in a large glass pan.
Spread salsa sauce over the cream cheese layer.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the salsa layer.
Add chopped red pepper, green pepper, and tomato on top.
Serve with baked nacho chips.

_similar.keywords: nacho dip, creamy dip, taco seasoning, salsa dip
